name: Cost ceiling
optimizes: Expensive single calls are downshifted, and a hard per-request cost cap blocks runaway spend.
description: When a request's estimated cost crosses a threshold, reroute it to a cheaper model and enforce a hard per-request ceiling. If even the cheaper model would exceed the ceiling, the gateway rejects the request (402) instead of silently spending. Tune estimated_cost_gt and max_cost_usd to your budget.
